displacement.def: The change in position of a particle over a time interval: $x(b) - x(a) = \int_a^b v(t)\,dt$. It can be positive, negative or zero.

total-distance.def: The length of the path a particle travels over a time interval, counting motion in both directions as positive: $\int_a^b |v(t)|\,dt$, the integral of speed.
